description:
Eaton’s Power Components Division, within the Americas region of the Electrical Sector, is looking for a Metering and Monitoring Product Engineer. This role reports into the Marketing Organization. 
 The expected annual salary range for this role is $97, 000 - $143, 000 per year. 
 Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. 
 What you’ll do:
 
 The Product Engineer will serve as the technical authority for meters by translating product and application knowledge into customer-facing documentation, engineering support, and cross-functional guidance that enables proper product application, supports business growth, and drives successful product lifecycle management.
  
 A Product Engineer for meters is responsible for providing deep technical expertise across the full product lifecycle, with a strong focus on application support, technical content development, customer problem resolution, and new product support. This role ensures that meter products are accurately represented, properly applied, and effectively supported in the market through collaboration with engineering, marketing, sales, quality, and customers.
 
 ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS  
 Develop technical thought leadership content, including white papers and application-focused materials, to communicate product capabilities, technical considerations, and industry insights.
 Lead application-based technical analysis and provide guidance on the correct use of meter products in customer and market applications.
 Create, review, and maintain technical documentation, including instruction manuals, operating manuals, maintenance manuals, and other product literature.
 Support technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders regarding product application, performance, and use-case requirements.
 Partner with product managers to provide technical knowledge that strengthens product positioning, messaging, and customer engagement.
 Support new product development efforts by contributing application expertise, technical requirements, and documentation needed for successful product launches.
 Assist with strategic customer escalations by helping resolve complex technical issues, clarifying application concerns, and supporting high-priority customer needs.
 Participate in strategic planning activities by providing customer-informed technical perspectives that support long-term product development and market positioning decisions.
 Provide technical training and continued education for other customer support resources at Eaton, building internal capability and ensuring consistent technical guidance across the organization.
 Contribute to product quality improvements by capturing, analyzing, and addressing customer-reported technical issues and collaborating with internal manufacturing quality personnel.
 Engage with targeted end-users to drive specification of Eaton components, thus creating demand for Eaton across multiple OEMs and interunit customers.
 Represent the product line at technical events and industry groups to actively participate in and shape industry codes and standards.
 

 Qualifications:
 
 Basic/Required Qualifications – new draft: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited institution.
 Minimum of two (2) years of experience in sales, marketing, or engineering with electrical products, power distribution, building automation, complex electronic devices, monitoring systems, test equipment, robotics, sensor systems, or similar technologies.
 Sponsorship is not provided. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US on an ongoing basis without company sponsorship. 
   
 Preferred Qualifications – new draft: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Software Engineering.
 Strong understanding of power distribution and/or electrical machine control systems, applications and their associated components
 Manufacturing / operations / design awareness, understanding, and financial impact to product line performance
 

 Skills:
 
 Position Criteria: 
 Excellent communication, organizational and interpersonal skills
 Excellent presentation skills and public speaking experience
 Demonstrated problem-solving ability
 Ability to learn market influences
 Ability to work effectively in team environment and independently
 Customer service skills
 Ability and interest in learning product management and marketing concepts.
 


 All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.  
  
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.   
  
 At Eaton we leverage artificial intelligence to recommend jobs to you that match the skills and experience required for the open role. Our Talent Acquisition teams also uses AI to identify applicants whose skills are a match for the job.  Hiring decisions are made by Eaton leaders through a structured interview process and not AI. 
  
 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, color, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law. 
  
 We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click Benefits at Eaton Canada / Avantages sociaux chez Eaton Canada  for more detail. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
